event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,586 parameters at 99.020000%, a +0.020000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 65 prior macro-attempts in this family and 552 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0166/micro-0006 at 1,590 parameters and 99.02%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0167/micro-0001 (FF-output pair 180/59 discarded at 98.96%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 183 and 223, values 0.0255113114 and 0.0257297587 (difference 2.184e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,585 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 2.225e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
